content:
Movement remains completely frozen regardless of direction, duration, or combination. The body is stuck at (2,7) and cannot move to any adjacent tile.

I cannot complete the task: my body is permanently frozen at (2,7) — every movement input (all directions, short taps, long holds, diagonals, and the walk helper) only changes facing but never moves me to an adjacent tile, even though the map and interact checks confirm the surrounding tiles are open and walkable. Without movement I cannot gather 3 Wood and 2 Stone or reach the workbench to craft the Crown.
